$comment: Brand marks Fabricator ships. Edit this file, then run bun run icons:brands. A held mark stays out of every package; the reason says why.

brands.name: airbnb
brands.title: Airbnb
brands.held: Airbnb forbids using its logos or icons without formal written permission (https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/3233).

brands.name: aws
brands.title: Amazon Web Services
brands.held: AWS licenses its logos only to customers and partners for specific uses, and fair use is plain text only (https://aws.amazon.com/trademark-guidelines/).

brands.name: google-cloud
brands.title: Google Cloud
brands.held: Google Cloud allows a plain-text mention only; its logo and icon need approval from Google's Cloud brand team (https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/external_customer_co_branding_eligibility.pdf).

brands.name: gsap
brands.title: GSAP
brands.held: GSAP is a Webflow trademark, and Webflow's policy allows text references only and forbids changing its logos' colour (https://webflow.com/legal/trademark-usage-policy).

brands.name: linux
brands.title: Linux
brands.credit: Tux by Larry Ewing (lewing@isc.tamu.edu) and The GIMP. Linux® is the registered trademark of Linus Torvalds.

brands.name: microsoft
brands.title: Microsoft
brands.held: Microsoft licenses its logos to third parties only by formal agreement (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/publish/partner-center/trademark-and-copyright-protection).

brands.name: mysql
brands.title: MySQL
brands.held: Oracle limits the MySQL logo to MySQL representatives and companies with a written agreement (https://www.mysql.com/about/legal/logos.html).

brands.name: openai
brands.title: OpenAI
brands.held: OpenAI's usage terms make its logo permission non-transferable (https://openai.com/brand/#usage-terms), and Simple Icons removed this older mark at OpenAI's request. Held until OpenAI grants redistribution.

brands.name: php
brands.title: PHP
brands.credit: PHP logo by Colin Viebrock, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://www.php.net/download-logos.php), reduced to one colour by Simple Icons.

brands.name: playwright
brands.title: Playwright
brands.held: Playwright is a Microsoft product: its Apache-2.0 licence grants no trademark rights, and Microsoft licenses its logos only by agreement (https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/LICENSE).

brands.name: python
brands.title: Python
brands.held: The PSF requires permission for logos in other colours and publishes no one-colour logo (https://www.python.org/psf/trademarks/). Its policy says such requests are likely to be approved.

brands.name: slack
brands.title: Slack
brands.held: Slack's brand terms forbid distributing its logo files (https://slack.com/terms-of-service/slack-brand).

brands.name: terraform
brands.title: Terraform
brands.held: HashiCorp doesn't license its product logos to the public; apart from linking to the project from your own website, every use needs its written approval (https://www.hashicorp.com/en/trademark-policy).

brands.name: visual-studio-code
brands.title: Visual Studio Code
brands.held: Microsoft forbids modified versions of the VS Code icon, which a one-colour mark is (https://code.visualstudio.com/brand).
